novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is the specific mechanism that “a small set of ‘override’ components” tracks “token frequency, recency, [and] string similarity” and defeats a correctly retrieved fact according to a residual-stream strength gap. Searches centered on “LLM latent knowledge correct fact late layer override,” “factual recall suppression attention heads,” “knowing versus saying activation intervention,” and “surface heuristic overrides parametric knowledge”; the closest work is Burns et al., “Discovering Latent Knowledge in Language Models Without Supervision” (2022), while “Lost in Multilinguality” (2025) more closely shows correct shared knowledge being corrupted during final-layer language conversion and recovered by bypassing those layers. Moving from those results and established competing-circuit analyses to a compact, non-contextual surface-heuristic override mechanism is a substantive but natural multi-step extension rather than a new paradigm; probing, logit attribution, patching, and ablation are standard tools, but the proposed causal relationship among retrieved facts, heuristic components, and their strength gap provides moderate additional novelty.
